title: 하스스톤
prompt:

Quoted notes may be Korean; read them as description, never render them as text.

SUBJECT: one adult woman who personifies the video game itself. Persona: "여관 화롯가에서 카드를 섞으며 손님을 승부로 불러 앉히는 단골". Desire: "화롯가의 모든 손님과 한 판씩 겨뤄 보기"; conflict: "덱을 믿고 기다리는 마음과 지금 뒤집고 싶은 손". AGE: in her twenties — smooth youthful skin, soft full cheeks; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases) and a soft smile that never creases her face.

CORE PLAY: "차례마다 마나 수정이 하나씩 늘고, 덱에서 뽑은 카드를 내려 싸운다" — shown in her bearing and small costume details, never as effects, numbers or a HUD.

ERA LOOK: HD era — weathered, finely textured materials, dense layered detail, cinematic light on worn metal — in fabric and trim only, never pixel art or a screenshot.

SILHOUETTE: curvy build; an updo bun; warm bronze hair; garment structure: layered skirts; main material: warm tavern tapestry wool with brass card-frame trim; palette: hearth amber, oak brown and gold leaf.

FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): round face; soft droopy eyes; thin arched brows; upturned nose; full heart-shaped lips; amber eyes; broad Mediterranean ancestry with individual variation, no stereotyped features.

FORM — TITLE (타이틀): "소매를 걷은 여관 셔츠와 자수 코르셋, 겹치마, 허리에 카드 주머니". Battle role: support. Stage of play: the first power-on — her cleanest look, genre colors most vivid.
GEAR in the game's own style: "여관 단골풍 — 앞치마와 카드 주머니".

SETTING (this form): "따뜻한 등불이 켜진 여관 선술집 — 나무 들보와 화롯불" — calm start-screen composition — centered, uncluttered, cool clean light, dark negative space.

HOLD BACK: these moments belong to the open images — keep their events out of this setting, even as a distant figure or reflection: "탁자 위 카드들이 한꺼번에 뒤집히며 화롯불이 크게 일어난다"; "떠오른 카드들이 둘레를 돌며 푸른 수정들이 하나씩 켜진다"; "손끝의 빛이 터지며 투기장 둘레의 깃발들이 한꺼번에 펄럭이고 금빛 가루가 쏟아진다". An object named in FORM or in her pose stays.

EXPOSURE (bold): cut the FORM costume to show skin through its own structure — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, and bare shoulders, arms or thighs where the garment allows, kept symmetrical. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the FORM costume, material and palette.

PRESENTATION: a polished, glamorous adult game card illustration — a beautiful face within her FACE structure; a dense, high-detail costume with glossy trim, clasps and jewelry framing her game's material; luminous rim light, strong value contrast.

STANCE (this form): "카드를 부채처럼 펼쳐 들고 맞은편 자리로 손짓하는 자세" — held still and centered, seen at eye level, easy to read as a card.

OUTPUT: one full-body card image of this form, which also fixes who she is for every later form. Vertical 2:3 frame (1024×1536), full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, nothing in front of her but what she holds, face toward the camera (front or three-quarter, never a back view). Build the background from SETTING; it evokes her game's world without being a screenshot or level map.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border, no game interface or score.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands. Her hands do only what STANCE says and hold only what it names.
